vignette: A child returns after SDF was applied to a cavitated lesion on a primary molar. The lesion now looks black and feels hard.
stem: What is the most appropriate plan for ongoing management of this lesion?

options.text: Discharge the lesion from surveillance because hardness proves arrest is permanent.
Continue periodic monitoring for progression and reapply SDF over time if needed to maintain arrest.
Consider the treatment a failure because of the black color and remove the tooth structure.
Conclude that SDF cannot arrest caries and abandon it in the management plan.
